sources.title: Buzz architecture

sources.finding: One relay is authoritative for signed events, authentication, persistence, search and automation. Community host boundaries are explicit.

sources.title: Buzz CLI issues

sources.finding: CLI creates, reads, lists, changes issue status and publishes signed assignment events. Prior assignment-head checks constrain self operations.

sources.finding: Desktop signs and publishes the shared Git issue event with title/body/category and refreshes project issue queries.

sources.title: Buzz desktop package
sources.locator: Tauri scripts; React dependency
sources.finding: Pinned desktop build uses Tauri and React.

sources.title: Buzz README.md
sources.locator: Getting started; Quick start; Windows prerequisites
sources.finding: Default relay is localhost:3000; packaged clients can switch relay. Source setup requires Docker and Hermit or the listed Rust/Node/pnpm toolchain. Production Compose supports a single-node VPS relay. Windows agent shell requires Git Bash or BUZZ_SHELL.

sources.title: Buzz ARCHITECTURE.md
sources.locator: buzz-acp; buzz-workflow
sources.finding: buzz-acp runs 1–32 subprocesses, default one, queues mentions per channel with at most one prompt in flight, respawns crashed agents, and does not persist its state. Workflow concurrency is 100 permits and returns CapacityExceeded rather than queueing; cron evaluates every 60 seconds.

sources.title: Buzz ARCHITECTURE.md
sources.locator: buzz-auth; buzz-db; buzz-pubsub; buzz-audit; Known limitations
sources.finding: Channel membership roles are Owner, Admin, Member, Guest and Bot, with transactional member/channel operations and soft removal. NIP-42 and NIP-98 authenticate signed events. Audit is append-only SHA-256 hash chained, excludes ephemeral events, and can verify chains. Approval workflow gates are not wired end to end.

sources.title: Buzz README
sources.locator: 'What is this, really?'; 'I want my own hosted relay'
sources.finding: Buzz is a self-hostable workspace; a relay can be self-run or deployed to Railway via a one-click button, with no Buzz price stated.
